steps.operator_folder: 00 - Measure Hardware and Print Approved Parts
steps.operator_title: Measure Hardware and Print Approved Parts
steps.title: Preflight, measurement, print qualification, and kitting
steps.purpose: Measure the real hardware, qualify each exact material/profile, print only released jobs, and stage accepted parts before touching the finished board.
steps.expected_result: All required coupons, first articles, production parts, hardware kits, and native QIDI Studio records are accepted and traceable.
required_inputs: QIDI Plus4 with the installed 0.4 mm nozzle physically verified

Dry, identified QIDI ABS Rapido for active rigid jobs, an identified PETG lot for adapter jobs 00D/04B/04C, and an identified TPU lot for jobs 05A-05D; PETG general and ASA are additionally required only if the optional fixed-mast fallback is formally released
Actual keyboard, phone/case, cable, camera, RoArm gripper, spring, pins, inserts, nuts, screws, washers, and selected tool-route hardware

One selected board drill guide: output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_LETTER_1TO1.pdf for a tiled Letter-size print or output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_24X36_FULL_SIZE_1TO1.pdf for a single 24 x 36 inch sheet, printed at Actual Size / 100 percent, plus a steel rule and scale-control evidence photos
Responsible engineering approval records for phone clearance/TPU retention and every selected tool route; operators may not invent limits
Digital calipers, flatness tools, low-range torque driver, and an evidence folder

A selected tool route plus an explicit camera decision: camera_mast_optional means the independent fixed eye-to-hand fallback only, never the intended arm-mounted route; selection records scope but the fixed_camera_fallback_architecture_released gate still controls all fallback printing

hardware.condition: 305 x 305 x 280 mm nominal; physically verify the provisional 295 x 295 x 275 mm protected envelope before production printing
Record tool ID and measure only after parts cool
Required for board and station flatness
Must cover the controlled station-retainer range

hardware.item: QIDI ABS Rapido, PETG adapter filament, TPU, and optional fixed-mast PETG/ASA
hardware.condition: Use the exact job-card profile; track brand, lot, drying record, and saved profile revision
Use JOB_KITS.csv; segregate INSTALL, SPARE, HOLD, and REJECT

procedure: Phase 00.1 — Decide and initialize: read PRINT_READINESS.md; select one or both tool routes; record camera_mast_optional only as the independent fixed-mast fallback qualification scope, not as the intended arm-camera route or print authorization; run `python scripts/set_active_build.py --build-id YYYY-MM-DD_CELL-A`, regenerate this package, then run `python scripts/initialize_step_evidence.py --step 00` exactly once before recording any measurement or QIDI file.

Phase 00.2 — Measure real hardware before diagnostics: record the exact keyboard; phone/case; side buttons, camera bump, glass edge, and cable/connector envelope; camera mount and blind-thread depth; RoArm gripper; spring; pins; inserts; nuts; screws; washers; board blank; factory clamp footprint; material lots; nozzle; printer; and measurement-tool IDs in the active-build evidence and canonical measurement workflow. First set the required shared context with `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --context operator=NAME --context date=YYYY-MM-DD --context printer_serial=SERIAL --context measurement_tool_id=CALIPER_ID --context "evidence_directory=BUILD_BY_STEP/00 - Measure Hardware and Print Approved Parts/06 - SAVE MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS/BUILD_ID_HERE" --context qidi_studio_version=VERSION`, replacing every uppercase placeholder. Obtain responsible engineering approval IDs for the phone no-go margin, phone TPU proof, and every selected tool-route proof before accepting dependent measurements or coupons.

Phase 00.2A — Select one board drill guide: use output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_LETTER_1TO1.pdf for a normal Letter printer, or output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_24X36_FULL_SIZE_1TO1.pdf only when a print shop can produce one true 24 x 36 inch sheet. Do not combine pages from the two guides. For the Letter guide, pages 1-3 are reference pages marked not for drilling and pages 4-12 are the nine 1:1 tiles; print one-sided, at Actual Size / 100 percent, with no Fit, Shrink, Crop, borderless enlargement, or duplex option. Assemble the 3 x 3 field with the printed 12 mm overlaps and matching registration IDs; never butt paper edges or printer margins. For the full-size guide, print the single page at Actual Size / 100 percent on 24 x 36 inch media without scaling. Measure the independent X and Y 100 mm controls on every physical drilling sheet with a steel rule; each must measure 100.0 +/- 0.2 mm. Verify all matching registration marks on a tiled guide, or the board-edge/orientation controls on the full-size guide. Save ruler and registration/edge photos in the active-build Step 00 evidence folder. From the project root, set `$guidePath="output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_LETTER_1TO1.pdf"` or the full-size path, then run `$guideHash=(Get-FileHash $guidePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); $layoutHash=(Get-FileHash config/workcell_layout.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()` and `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --gate board_setup_template_scale_pass --status PASS --value template_revision=RC03-INT-R1 --value "selected_guide_path=$guidePath" --value "selected_guide_sha256=$guideHash" --value "source_layout_sha256=$layoutHash" --value x_scale_bar_mm=100.0 --value y_scale_bar_mm=100.0 --value "page_scaling_setting=Actual Size / 100 percent" --value all_sheet_registration_marks_result=PASS --evidence-note "Step 00 evidence: ruler and registration/edge photos for the selected drill guide"`, replacing both numeric values with the actual worst-case readings. A scale-control PASS checks print scale only; it is not a released hand-transfer position tolerance and does not replace the independent center audit or full station dry fit in Step 01.

Phase 00.3 — Print diagnostics first: print required jobs 00A, 00B, 00C, 00E, and 00F in order with the exact profile on each job card. Print job 00D only when `phone_stylus_route` is explicitly selected. The as-built 00B nut and cable-saddle features are superseded screening evidence and do not qualify the revised interfaces.

Phase 00.3A — Print Job 03C1 before Job 03A: after its listed prerequisites pass, print the small production-equivalent phone rail. On the loose rail, bench-qualify both redesigned captive-nut seats with the actual M4 nuts and screws, then feed the adopted nominal 4.8 mm tie around the actual USB cable through the 5.6 x 2.2 mm saddle. This is the authorized production first-article path; no separate replacement nut or tie coupon is required.
Save every diagnostic native QIDI project and layer-preview capture inside the Step 00 build-ID evidence folder. The canonical --qidi-job recording option is reserved for non-diagnostic release jobs.

Measure every coupon objectively and record raw values, units, instrument IDs, and evidence. If an accepted selection changes geometry, apply the controlled override and regenerate CAD, drawings, plates, readiness, tracker, job cards, and this step package.

Record and transfer the seam round-socket diameter, seam radial-slot width, phone-station M3 pocket diameter, and compliant-tool M3 pocket diameter independently. If any accepted value is not represented by its dedicated CAD parameter, stop and regenerate before production.
Phase 00.4 — Validate release: run the readiness validator after all measurement updates. A geometry-only 3MF and a digitally valid package are not permission to print a WAITING or NOT_SELECTED job.
Phase 00.5 — Slice and print released jobs: open each READY plate in QIDI Studio at 100 percent scale; do not auto-orient, globally scale, merge, or alter the object count.
Save the native QIDI Studio project and record QIDI version, profile revision, object count, critical layer-preview acceptance, mass, time, and project hash before starting the printer.
Print first articles before dependent production jobs: Job 03C1 before Job 03A, master before slave, first TPU tip before its batch, and mast first article before an optional second foot.
Phase 00.6 — Inspect and kit: cool, inspect, measure, label, and kit accepted parts. Quarantine anything warped, cracked, bridged shut, dimensionally out of limit, or untraceable.
Reconcile every accepted part, spare, fastener, device, and tool against JOB_KITS.csv, then confirm every Step 01-15 kit is staged before board fabrication begins.

acceptance.method: Print either the nine Letter drilling tiles or the single 24 x 36 inch guide at Actual Size / 100 percent; measure the independent X and Y 100 mm controls on every physical drilling sheet; verify every matching tiled registration mark or the full-size board-edge/orientation controls; record the selected path plus guide and source-layout SHA-256 values
acceptance.limit: Every X and Y control is 100.0 +/- 0.2 mm, all applicable registration/edge controls agree, and the recorded path and hashes match the exact files used; this scale check alone does not release hole positions

The retained 00A seam coupon remains with the keyboard master kit.
The accepted 00B phone-width, locator, M3-insert, and washer results remain with the phone/TCP kit; the failed 00B nut and cable-saddle objects remain labeled as superseded evidence.
The accepted Job 03C1 rail and its captive-nut and wide-tie evidence remain with the phone/TCP kit.
Every selected job has a native QIDI Studio evidence record.

steps.operator_folder: 01 - Seal Mark and Drill the Board
steps.operator_title: Seal Mark and Drill the Board
steps.title: Prepare and drill the structural board
steps.purpose: Create the flat, sealed, accurately indexed structural board using only a 1:1 paper template, hand drill, guides, and depth stops.
steps.expected_result: A cured 610 x 457 x 18 mm board with four blind locator interfaces and nine qualified M4 anchor interfaces, all inspected and labeled.
required_inputs: Accepted keyboard master/slave and phone/TCP stations for the full dry fit
610 x 457 x 18 mm board blank cut to final size; it may be unsealed, or already sealed equally on both faces and fully cured

Step-00 accepted copy of exactly one friendly 1:1 drill guide: the correctly overlapped nine-tile Letter guide or the single-sheet 24 x 36 inch guide, with its recorded path, hashes, print settings, and scale-control evidence
drawings/board_hole_coordinates.csv available for an independent left/front and right/rear edge-distance audit of all thirteen centers
Four selected 6 mm pins and nine board anchors qualified in an 18 mm cutoff
Hand drill, square drilling guide, awl/transfer punch, brad-point bit, pilot/anchor bits, and positive depth stops
Steel rule, 300 mm straightedge, feeler gauges, depth gauge, digital calipers, camera, and low-range torque driver
Board finish compatible with the selected plywood, applicators, mixing tray, lint-free cleanup supplies, gloves, eye protection, and the ventilation/PPE required by the finish SDS

hardware.condition: Birch plywood preferred; finish fully cured and flat
Final selection comes from the matching 00A/00B coupons
Bore follows the chosen anchor maker and scrap-board test, not the template circle diameter
Locator pins only; use after the complete dry fit passes
Record product, batch, coat/application times, and manufacturer full-cure requirement; apply equally to both faces and every edge

hardware.item: Finish-rated gloves, eye protection, and ventilation
hardware.condition: Follow the selected finish SDS; keep the curing board away from ignition and contamination sources
Locator bores are blind; prevent underside breakout

hardware.item: Flat assembly surface, transparent tape, low-stretch board tape, sharp awl or transfer punch, steel rule, and long straightedge
hardware.condition: For a tiled guide, overlap adjacent sheets by the printed 12 mm amount and match registration IDs; never butt paper or printer margins
Install after drilling; keep clear of anchors, reinforcement, and clamp load paths

procedure: Inspect the blank for damage. Measure and record the front and rear widths, left and right depths, board thickness near every named locator, both corner-to-corner diagonals, local flatness, and overall bow before layout. Accept only 610.0 +/- 0.5 mm width, 457.0 +/- 0.5 mm depth, and 17.50-18.50 mm thickness. Front/rear widths and left/right depths may differ by no more than 0.50 mm. Compute the expected diagonal from the mean measured width and depth; each diagonal must be within 1.00 mm of that value and the two diagonals must be within 1.00 mm of each other. Reject or obtain a controlled engineering disposition before layout if any limit fails.

If the board is unsealed, seal both faces and all edges equally and allow the finish to cure fully before taping paper or drilling. If it arrived sealed, verify equal coverage and full cure; do not apply an unnecessary second finish coat.

Retrieve the exact Step-00 accepted friendly guide and confirm its recorded path and SHA-256. Do not substitute the overview page, schedule page, assembly-map page, legacy alias, or pages from the other guide after acceptance. If a replacement is printed, repeat Step 00 acceptance and record the new exact file hash before use.

For the Letter guide, use pages 4-12 only as the 1:1 drilling field. On a flat surface, arrange the pages in the printed 3 x 3 map, overlap adjacent sheets by exactly the printed 12 mm zones, and align every duplicated registration mark and ID before taping the seams. Never butt sheet edges or unprinted printer margins; that creates a 12 mm error at one seam and a 24 mm cumulative error across two seams. Pages 1-3 are reference pages and must never be punched or drilled from. Skip this tiled-assembly action when using the accepted one-page 24 x 36 inch guide.

Before the guide touches the board, remeasure the independent X and Y 100 mm controls on every physical drilling sheet with a steel rule. Both directions on every sheet must be 100.0 +/- 0.2 mm. Reject any page with the wrong scale, missing marks, wrinkling, moisture distortion, stretched tape, or mismatched registration IDs. Scale controls prove print scale only; they are not a released final hole-position tolerance.

Place the finished guide on the cured board top. Register the board outline, FRONT, +X/right, and +Y/rear without stretching the paper. Confirm the guide's front-left origin sits at the board's front-left corner and that the opposite board edges, orientation arrow, clamp no-drill area, and tag-only symbols agree before taping the guide to the board.

Using drawings/board_hole_coordinates.csv, independently verify all thirteen feature IDs and centers from two directions: X from the left and right-edge remainder, and Y from the front and rear-edge remainder. Do not average conflicting marks. Stop and correct the guide registration if the paper mark and edge measurements disagree. Pay particular attention to PT-HOLD-R1 and PT-HOLD-R2, whose centers are only 21.2 mm from the right board edge; the selected anchor bore, flange, and installation tool still require physical edge-clearance proof.

Transfer exactly four blue round locator centers and nine orange square M4 anchor centers with a sharp awl or transfer punch. Do not transfer station outlines, dimensions, registration marks, clamp no-drill shading, or any TAG ONLY / NO DRILL symbol. Photograph the registered guide and all thirteen transferred centers before removing the paper.

Remove every paper fragment before drilling, then re-audit all thirteen center punches against drawings/board_hole_coordinates.csv. A printed M4 station/CAD passage reference is not a universal final board bore; the nine orange targets authorize center-punching only until FASTENER_MAP.csv is complete for the actual qualified anchor.

Pilot the four locator centers square using the hand-drill guide and a positive depth stop. At each named locator, record local thickness and set the final 6 mm brad-point operation to 15.00 +/- 0.20 mm while also preserving at least 2.00 mm of local board floor. If both conditions cannot be met, stop instead of accepting a thinner floor or underside breakout.
Drill the four locator bores only, deburr without enlarging them, measure every actual blind depth, and inspect the underside for breakout before any anchor bore is drilled.

Complete FASTENER_MAP.csv for all nine M4 interfaces using the actual anchor maker/part, qualified scrap-board result, selected screw length, bore mode, final board bore, bore depth or through condition, install face, pilot diameter, and qualification reference required by the controlled map. Do not leave a required selection blank and do not infer a bit size from the guide artwork.

Only after the complete fastener map is qualified, drill each of the nine final anchor bores square with the recorded pilot/final bits and depth/through control. Protect the two right-edge phone-rail locations from breakout, veneer splitting, and inadequate flange or tool clearance.
Install temporary anchors and pins; dry-fit all three stations, all nine retainers, the seam, and the rail-sharing stacks.
Only after the complete dry fit passes, epoxy the four locator pins, set and record each named exposed projection at 5.00 +/- 0.15 mm, allow full cure, and repeat the fit checks.

Run `(Get-FileHash FASTENER_MAP.csv -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()` from the project root and record the result as board_fabrication_pass.selected_fastener_map_sha256; any later map change reopens this step.
Mark FRONT and the revision on the underside; install feet clear of all anchors and reinforcement hardware.

acceptance.method: 300 mm straightedge and feelers
acceptance.limit: No more than 0.50 mm over any 300 mm span
acceptance.evidence: Worst measured span and photo

acceptance.method: Straightedge on cured board
acceptance.limit: No more than 1.50 mm over the full board
acceptance.evidence: Measured bow and photo

acceptance.criterion: Locator bores preserve a blind floor and pins have controlled projection
acceptance.method: Record thickness, depth, and cured projection by the four named locator IDs; inspect the underside
acceptance.limit: Each depth is 15.00 +/- 0.20 mm and leaves at least 2.00 mm local floor; no breakout; each exposed projection is 5.00 +/- 0.15 mm
acceptance.evidence: ID-keyed local thicknesses, actual depths, underside photos, depth-stop setup, and cured projections

acceptance.criterion: All qualified station interfaces dry fit
acceptance.method: Verify all nine anchor rows are complete, then install all stations and nine stacks by hand
acceptance.limit: Every final bore is traceable to its actual qualified anchor; no rocking, binding, bottoming, base lift, veneer damage, or underside projection
acceptance.evidence: Dry-fit photos, fully completed FASTENER_MAP.csv, scrap-board qualification references, and recorded map SHA-256

acceptance.method: Inspect both faces and every edge; compare elapsed cure time/conditions with the selected finish instructions
acceptance.limit: Both faces and every edge evenly sealed and fully cured; no tack, print transfer, contamination, or finish-induced warping
acceptance.evidence: Finish product/batch, SDS/PPE record, application and cure timestamps, and face/edge photos

acceptance.criterion: Board geometry and selected drill-guide registration pass before center transfer
acceptance.method: Measure front/rear widths, left/right depths, thicknesses, and both diagonals; calculate the edge-derived diagonal; verify guide path/hash, FRONT/origin, board edges, every X/Y scale control, and all applicable registration IDs
acceptance.limit: Width 610.0 +/- 0.5 mm; depth 457.0 +/- 0.5 mm; thickness 17.50-18.50 mm; opposite like edges differ by no more than 0.50 mm; each diagonal is within 1.00 mm of the edge-derived value and the pair differs by no more than 1.00 mm; every X/Y scale control is 100.0 +/- 0.2 mm; no guide-edge or registration disagreement
acceptance.evidence: Six board-dimension readings, four local thickness readings, diagonal calculation, selected-guide record, ruler photos, assembled-guide photo, and registration/edge-control photos

acceptance.criterion: All thirteen transferred centers match the controlled coordinate schedule
acceptance.method: Before drilling, identify each punch by feature ID and cross-check X from left/right plus Y from front/rear against drawings/board_hole_coordinates.csv
acceptance.limit: Exactly four locator and nine anchor centers are present; all four edge-distance checks agree for every ID; no tag, outline, dimension, or registration mark is transferred; any disagreement is corrected before drilling
acceptance.evidence: Signed thirteen-row center audit and overhead photos before and after paper removal

extra_files.role: friendly tiled Letter-size 1:1 drill guide; choose this or the full-size guide
friendly single-sheet 24 x 36 inch 1:1 drill guide; choose this or the Letter guide
legacy compatibility alias; use the selected friendly guide named in the Step-00 acceptance record

steps.stop_gate: Stop before center transfer or drilling if the board misses any released cut-size, thickness, opposite-edge, diagonal, flatness, or bow limit; any X/Y scale control is wrong; a Letter tile is butted instead of overlapped by 12 mm; registration or edge checks disagree; a station first article is unaccepted; a locator cannot meet both 15.00 +/- 0.20 mm depth and 2.00 mm minimum floor; or any anchor lacks a completed qualified FASTENER_MAP row and scrap-board proof.
handoff: The exact selected guide, its hash, every scale-control reading, tiled registration or full-sheet edge verification, and the thirteen-row coordinate audit are retained with Step 01 evidence.
All thirteen board interfaces are identified and inspected.
Four pins have controlled projection and no breakout.
Nine anchors accept the chosen stacks without bottoming or underside projection.
All three stations complete a dry-fit cycle, then are removed before Step 02.
All six feet are installed clear of every anchor and future reinforcement/clamp load path.

steps.operator_folder: 02 - Reinforce Board and Clamp Robot Arm
steps.operator_title: Reinforce Board and Clamp Robot Arm
steps.title: Reinforce the board and clamp the arm
steps.purpose: Spread the factory RoArm clamp load with measured precut metal while keeping the factory clamp as the load-bearing interface.
steps.expected_result: The board remains flat and stable under the factory clamp, with reinforcement, feet, anchors, and motion volume clear of one another.
required_inputs: Finished and accepted structural board
Factory RoArm clamp and measured factory-clamp footprint
Precut reinforcement plate sized from the physical clamp
Feet, safety cutoff, straightedge, feelers, and force gauge or traceable weights

hardware.item: Waveshare RoArm-M3 Pro and factory clamp
hardware.condition: Factory clamp remains load-bearing
Minimum 3 mm aluminum or 2 mm steel; footprint is measured, not taken from the schematic image
Keep outside robot reach
Clear anchors, plate, and clamp loads

procedure: Measure the actual factory-clamp contact footprint and confirm the precut plate covers that load path.
Deburr the metal plate and protect the board finish from sharp edges.
Position the plate under the rear arm-clamp zone, clear of feet, board anchors, locator bores, and station screws.
Install the factory clamp over the reinforced zone and tighten evenly without crushing the board or inducing twist.
Recheck local board flatness near the clamp and verify every board foot remains supported.

Keep the arm de-energized and do not manually force or back-drive any joint. Use the CAD envelope and static visual checks only at this step. Defer all powered envelope sampling to final commissioning after the E-stop, controller/firmware identity, approved motion limits, and empty-cell program are in place.
Install and test the accessible latching power cutoff before powered commissioning.

acceptance.method: Straightedge and feelers before and after clamp load
acceptance.limit: No new local lift above the board acceptance limit
acceptance.evidence: Before/after measurements and underside photo

acceptance.method: Visual and tactile inspection from the underside
acceptance.limit: No contact with anchors, feet, station hardware, or cable paths
acceptance.evidence: Underside overview photo

acceptance.criterion: Factory arm clamp is installed and stable
acceptance.method: Record the clamp model/instructions and manufacturer-approved tightening setting, then perform static before/after mounting inspections without forcing or back-driving the arm
acceptance.limit: Installation matches the clamp manufacturer; no clamp movement, board crushing, new bow, or permanent board shift
acceptance.evidence: Clamp model/instruction reference, tightening setting, and before/after reference measurements

steps.stop_gate: The clamp illustration is schematic and there is no released plate CAD. Do not fabricate from the picture; use the measured physical clamp footprint and stop if the board bows or any anchor is obstructed.
handoff: Factory clamp and measured metal spreader are installed and photographed.
Board flatness remains within the Step 01 limits.
E-stop is installed and accessible.
The robot remains de-energized and the empty fixture area is ready for the keyboard master.

steps.title: Install the keyboard master station
steps.purpose: Establish the keyboard coordinate system from the left/master station's round and radial locator pair.
steps.expected_result: The left station is squarely seated on two pins and three board interfaces, with its padded slider captured, parked fully rearward, and not loading a keyboard.
required_inputs: Accepted RC03-L master station and one accepted padded rear-clamp slider
Two installed keyboard locator pins
KBL-HOLD-F, KBL-HOLD-R, and KBL-CLAMP hardware stacks selected by the cutoff test
Retained job 00A seam ladder and the accepted master first-article record
Low-range torque driver, feeler gauges, lint-free cleaning supplies, and camera for evidence

hardware.condition: Accepted Job 01
Accepted Job 03B with one face pad
Round fixes XY; radial slot relieves one axis
Front and rear conventional stacks plus the low-profile slider/station stack

procedure: Confirm FRONT and +Y/rear, then clean the board contact plane and station underside.
Place the accepted padded slider in the master guide, park it fully rearward, and hold it there before installing the shared third retainer.
Align both locator sockets over the round and radial pins; lower the station squarely without rocking or prying.
Start KBL-HOLD-F and KBL-HOLD-R with washers by hand and leave them loose.
Pass the KBL-CLAMP low-profile screw and washer through the slider and station into its board interface; leave it loose.
Press the continuous base gently against the board and tighten all three in stages to 0.25-0.35 N m while the slider remains parked rearward.
Verify the station is fully seated, the slider is captured in the parked position, and the seam posts remain clean and undamaged. The shared screw may lock slider motion until Step 05.

acceptance.criterion: Station seats freely on both locators
acceptance.method: Install/remove by hand without retainers
acceptance.limit: No cracks, whitening, pry force, or measurable rocking
acceptance.evidence: Close photos of both sockets and seated base

acceptance.method: Feeler measurement before clamping
acceptance.limit: No more than 0.75 mm
acceptance.evidence: Worst corner value

acceptance.method: Torque driver and underside inspection
acceptance.limit: At least 5 mm engagement; no bottoming or underside projection; 0.25-0.35 N m final torque
acceptance.evidence: Selected lengths and three torque values

steps.stop_gate: Do not force either locator, omit the slider from the shared stack, or tighten the shared screw as a device clamp before the keyboard is loaded.
handoff: The master station is fully seated and torqued.
The master slider is captured, padded, and parked fully rearward for Step 05 adjustment.
The seam posts are clean and ready to receive the slave station.

steps.title: Join and retain the keyboard slave station
steps.purpose: Extend the keyboard support from the master seam without creating a second, conflicting locator system.
steps.expected_result: The right/slave station is seam-located, held by three relieved board interfaces, flush with the master, and free of rocking.
required_inputs: Installed master station
Accepted RC03-R slave station and second padded slider
KBR-HOLD-F, KBR-HOLD-R, and KBR-CLAMP hardware stacks
Feeler gauges, straightedge, low-range torque driver, and camera for seam, support-plane, torque, and evidence checks

hardware.condition: Accepted Job 02 after the master first article
Accepted Job 03B with one face pad
Relieved holes clamp only; the seam owns XY and yaw

procedure: Place the second padded slider in the slave guide, park it fully rearward, and hold it there before the shared third retainer is installed.
Align both slave seam sockets with the master's round post and Y-relieving feature before lowering.
Lower the slave straight down and seat the seam by hand; there are no independent right-side locator pins.
Start KBR-HOLD-F and KBR-HOLD-R with washers loosely.
Pass KBR-CLAMP through the slider and relieved station hole into the board anchor; leave it loose.

Before final tightening, verify the selected screw in each of the three stacks has at least 5 mm of thread engagement and cannot bottom in a blind interface or project below the board; change only to a separately verified length if any stack fails this check.

Confirm the seam is fully seated, then tighten all three stacks incrementally to 0.25-0.35 N m with a low-range torque driver while the slider remains parked rearward; record the final torque for each named stack.

With the board unloaded, measure seam gap, flush mismatch, and the combined support plane, then press alternate slave-station corners and use a feeler gauge at any lifting corner to check for rocking.

acceptance.method: Feeler gauges along the seam
acceptance.limit: No more than 0.40 mm
acceptance.evidence: Worst gap and location

acceptance.method: Straightedge and feeler
acceptance.limit: No more than 0.25 mm
acceptance.evidence: Worst mismatch and photo

acceptance.method: Straightedge across both stations
acceptance.limit: No more than 0.40 mm variation
acceptance.evidence: Measured range

acceptance.method: Verify selected screw length and engagement before final tightening; record each stack with a low-range torque driver and inspect the underside/interface after tightening
acceptance.limit: At least 5 mm thread engagement in every stack; no blind-interface bottoming or underside projection; 0.25-0.35 N m final torque for KBR-HOLD-F, KBR-HOLD-R, and KBR-CLAMP
acceptance.evidence: Selected screw lengths, engagement check, three named final torque values, and underside/interface photos

acceptance.method: With the board unloaded, press alternate slave-station corners and check any lifting corner with a feeler gauge

Accepted Jobs 05A/05B; label INSTALL and SPARE
Advance only to gentle TPU contact

steps.title: Transfer the AprilTag centers and +Y direction
steps.purpose: Use the verified paper template only to transfer six centers and orientation marks onto the cured board.
steps.expected_result: All six tag centers and +Y/rear orientation marks are visible on the board, and all paper has been removed before adhesive work.
required_inputs: Cured, clean board with FRONT and +Y/rear known

The same accepted physical 1:1 guide recorded in Step 00: either output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_LETTER_1TO1.pdf or output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_24X36_FULL_SIZE_1TO1.pdf; do not mix the two routes
Accepted reusable 55 mm application frame
Fine removable pencil, low-tack tape, steel rule, and lint-free cleaning supplies; do not puncture or score an adhesive site

hardware.condition: Accepted Job 03C2; it is removed after each application

hardware.item: Released Letter tiled guide or released 24 x 36 inch full-size guide
hardware.condition: Path/hash matches the Step 00 record; both 100 mm scale bars are reverified immediately before use; Letter pages 1-3 are reference only and pages 4-12 form the 1:1 field with 12 mm overlaps

procedure: Unload devices or protect them from paper, marking, and cleaning debris.

Retrieve the same accepted physical guide recorded in Step 00 and confirm its route, file path, SHA-256, FRONT, and +Y/rear orientation. Do not substitute a newly printed or rebuilt guide without repeating the Step 00 scale and registration acceptance.

For the Letter guide, pages 1-3 are overview/schedule/tile-map reference pages and must not be used for transfer. Use only pages 4-12 as the 3 x 3 full-scale field; overlap every adjacent tile by the printed 12 mm zones, align each duplicated registration cross and matching ID, and never butt paper edges or printer margins.
For the 24 x 36 inch full-size alternative, use its one full-size page only at Actual Size / 100 percent; do not tile, crop, or combine it with any Letter page.

Reverify both independent 100 mm scale bars with a steel rule. For the Letter route also reverify every 12 mm overlap and matching registration ID; for the full-size route reverify the board-edge and orientation controls.
Register and tape the accepted transfer field to the board outline, FRONT, +X/right, and +Y/rear without stretching it.
Transfer the center and +Y/rear direction mark for T0, T1, T2, T3, K0, and P0.
Confirm the logical labels map to AprilTag IDs 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively.
Remove every piece of paper and tape; do not place adhesive through the template.
Place the square application frame on each transferred center and verify the +Y witness before proceeding.

acceptance.criterion: Selected transfer-guide identity, scale, and registration
acceptance.method: Compare route/path/hash to the Step 00 record; check both scale bars with a steel rule; inspect every Letter overlap/registration ID or the full-size board-edge/orientation controls
acceptance.limit: Accepted route and hash match Step 00; both bars measure 100.0 +/- 0.2 mm at Actual Size; every Letter seam has the printed 12 mm overlap with matching IDs and no butted edge, or the one-page 24 x 36 guide passes its edge/orientation controls
acceptance.evidence: Selected route/path/hash plus photos of both ruler checks and all Letter seams or full-size edge/orientation controls

released one-page 24 x 36 inch full-size transfer-guide alternative

All paper and tape are removed.

steps.title: Apply and measure the six AprilTags
steps.purpose: Apply IDs 0-5 directly to the cured board with full-surface matte adhesive and measure their installed optical geometry.
steps.expected_result: Six correctly oriented tags are flat and physically measured, and a measured-installation runtime map is generated for Step 13; the application frame is removed and stored.
required_inputs: Transferred centers and +Y marks from Step 11
One measured set of six matte full-surface adhesive tiles plus a complete spare set
Accepted 55 mm application frame

Verified long-range digital scale/caliper system with resolution no worse than 0.05 mm and stated uncertainty no worse than 0.10 mm over the required board span; machinist square, depth/height gauge, feelers, removable fine pencil, camera, lint-free wipes, and finish-compatible cleaner

A recorded physical metrology method and uncertainty budget: measure X/Y from the board origin to two tile edges and calculate center; calculate yaw from two edge offsets over a measured baseline; measure optical-plane Z from the finished board top

hardware.condition: 55.0 mm tile, 40.0 mm detection edge, matte full-surface adhesive
Placement aid only; remove after every tag

procedure: Verify every tile's physical size, detection-edge size, ID, print quality, and top orientation before exposing adhesive.
At T0, align the application frame to the transferred center and +Y/rear mark.
Apply ID 0 directly to the cured board with full-surface pressure and no trapped bubbles.
Remove the frame and repeat exactly for T1/ID1, T2/ID2, T3/ID3, K0/ID4, and P0/ID5.

For every tag, use the verified long-range digital system to measure two perpendicular edges from the board origin and calculate center X/Y; measure two edge offsets over a recorded baseline to calculate yaw; use a feeler/straightedge for edge lift; and use a depth/height method from the finished board top for optical-plane Z. Record raw values, resolution, uncertainty, and calculations.
Capture a straight-on evidence image of each tag and a full-board image showing all IDs and orientation.

After every Step 12 physical criterion passes, record `tag_plane_placement_measured` as PASS with the six exact center X/Y, optical-plane Z, and yaw values plus nonblank measurement method, tool ID, and evidence reference. Do not generate or use a measured map while this gate is NOT_TESTED or HOLD.

From the project root run `python scripts/generate_fiducials.py --map-only`, then run `python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; p=json.loads(Path('fiducials/apriltag_map.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')); assert p['coordinate_source']=='measured_installation' and p['measurement']['status']=='PASS' and set(p['tags'])=={'T0','T1','T2','T3','K0','P0'}; print('measured map PASS')"`. Stop if either command fails or the generator summary does not report `coordinate_source` as `measured_installation` and `direct_tags` as 6. Record `(Get-FileHash fiducials/apriltag_map.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()` with the Step 12 evidence for Step 13.
Store the clean application frame and the labeled spare tag set away from the board.

acceptance.method: Calipers/rule on every installed and spare tile
acceptance.limit: Tile 55.0 +/- 0.2 mm; detection edge 40.0 +/- 0.2 mm
acceptance.evidence: Measured tile table

acceptance.method: Verified <=0.05 mm-resolution origin-to-edge center measurement, two-offset baseline yaw calculation, and straightedge/feeler edge-lift check
acceptance.limit: Center no more than 0.50 mm; yaw no more than 0.30 degrees; edge lift no more than 0.20 mm; measurement uncertainty no more than 0.10 mm
acceptance.evidence: Instrument verification/uncertainty, raw edge distances, calculations, six-row metrology table, and photos

acceptance.method: Measure tag-stock plus compressed adhesive Z for each tile
acceptance.limit: All six installed Z values recorded
acceptance.evidence: Six optical-plane values

acceptance.method: After the physical measurement gate is PASS, regenerate fiducials/apriltag_map.json with scripts/generate_fiducials.py --map-only and run the six-name/source assertion
acceptance.limit: coordinate_source is measured_installation; measurement status is PASS; T0, T1, T2, T3, K0, and P0 are present exactly once with the recorded measured geometry
acceptance.evidence: Generator and assertion console output plus the generated apriltag_map.json SHA-256

steps.failure_recovery: If artwork scale, tag stock, or the application-frame print is invalid, return to Step 00 and requalify it. If a transferred center/orientation mark is wrong, return to Step 11. If one tag is damaged or misapplied, keep Step 12 on HOLD, replace that tag, and repeat all affected physical measurements before continuing.
steps.stop_gate: Stop if a tile is glossy, scaled, damaged, rotated, misidentified, only spot-taped, or outside placement limits. Do not leave the printed application frame on the board.
handoff: All six direct-applied tags pass size and physical placement metrology; vision detection remains pending Step 13.
Installed center, yaw, edge lift, and optical Z are recorded per ID.
After `tag_plane_placement_measured` is PASS, fiducials/apriltag_map.json is regenerated, verified as measured_installation for exactly T0-T3/K0/P0, and its SHA-256 is handed to Step 13.
The application frame and spare set are labeled and stored.

acceptance.criterion: Tripod collision envelope and fail-stop injections
acceptance.method: Screen the installed support and cable against every approved swept volume and inject support shift, tilt, cable pull, tag loss, stale frame, and witness mismatch
acceptance.limit: Collision screen passes and every consequential injected fault blocks descent
acceptance.evidence: Installed collision geometry, swept-volume reports, injection receipts, and no-descent results

extra_files.role: active tripod installation and qualification procedure
historical RC03 calibration target retained for traceability; not the repository-authoritative B0477 production target
historical RC03 calibration artwork retained for traceability
historical RC03 calibration definition retained for traceability

steps.failure_recovery: If source hashes or received identities differ, stop and revise the intake under change control. If pose, stability, visibility, collision, or an injection fails, keep motion and contact blocked, correct the installation, create a new evidence attempt, and repeat every affected check.
steps.stop_gate: Stop before installation if the received tripod, B0477, adapter, thread, or support geometry is unidentified. Stop before robot power or motion while any intake measurement is missing, any authority field is false, any collision screen is incomplete, or any consequential fault fails to block descent.
handoff: The hash-bound intake records received identities, mount stack, support geometry, installed pose, stability, qualification results, and retained evidence.
B0477 identity, runtime mode, controls, orientation, calibration, and hashes are locked.
All six fiducials and every complete model crop footprint are visible at the qualified pose.
Installed tripod and cable collision geometry pass every approved swept-volume screen, and all wrong-model injections block descent.
Authority remains explicitly false pending the separate robot-power, motion, and contact approval process.

steps.title: Assemble and qualify the compliant tool
steps.purpose: Build and qualify every selected contact-tool route around the shared compliant body, one configuration at a time, and verify travel, force, retention, function, and TCP repeatability.
steps.expected_result: Each selected rod/TPU and/or stylus configuration has smooth controlled travel, returns freely, remains retained, functions correctly, and has a recorded calibrated TCP.
required_inputs: Accepted shared compliant body and keyed cap
Selected and accepted compression spring
One or both configured routes selected: keyboard rod/TPU, phone stylus, or both; never install both route stacks simultaneously
Two M3 inserts and two M3 x 10 cap screws
Calipers, calibrated low-range force gauge, retention-test fixture, and a TCP probe method

PASS engineering-release record `tool_force_tcp_limits_approved` containing numeric route-specific compression-force, retention-proof, and TCP-repeatability limits; operators may not choose arbitrary limits

hardware.item: Compliant body and keyed top caps
hardware.condition: Accepted Job 04A
OD, ID, free length, and rate qualified by Job 00C

hardware.item: M3 inserts and M3 x 10 button-head screws
hardware.condition: Insert and head fits selected by the exact tool profile

hardware.item: 6 mm rod + bushing + TPU tip and/or measured stylus + collar
hardware.condition: Build and test each selected configuration separately; do not combine route-specific stacks
Range and resolution must meet the engineering-approved compression and retention proof record

procedure: Confirm every selected route in the canonical measurement record. Label and segregate unselected-route parts; if both routes are selected, stage two labeled configurations and test them one at a time.
Install the two M3 inserts square in the compliant body using the accepted pocket and installation method.
Fit the selected spring and confirm it is centered, unbound, and clear of the sliding member.
Install the first selected route: either the accepted 6 mm rod/bushing/TPU tip stack or the accepted measured stylus/collar stack.
Align the keyed cap and install both M3 screws evenly without washers unless the released design is revised.

Cycle full compliant travel at least 20 times; measure travel and compression force at the engineering-approved checkpoints, and verify full return, no coil bind, no scraping, and secure route retention.
Install in the RoArm gripper using the accepted grip interface. Perform at least ten remove/reinstall/probe cycles and compare the XYZ range with the numeric TCP limit selected before assembly.
If a second route is selected, remove and label the first configuration, assemble the second route, and repeat every travel, force, retention, function, and TCP test.

acceptance.criterion: Compliant travel and force for every selected route
acceptance.method: Measure axial travel and force through at least 20 cycles
acceptance.limit: 3-6 mm smooth travel, free return, no coil bind, and force within the approved route-specific engineering-release envelope
acceptance.evidence: Approval ID, travel/force table, gauge ID, and cycle video

acceptance.criterion: TCP repeatability for every selected route
acceptance.method: Ten remove/reinstall/probe cycles using the approved probe and reference frame
acceptance.limit: XYZ range is at or below the approved route-specific engineering-release limit
acceptance.evidence: Approval ID, ten XYZ results per route, probe method, and calibrated TCP record

keyboard_rod_route.method: Qualified axial force-gauge pull plus 24-hour creep check
keyboard_rod_route.limit: Meets both engineering-approved rod-bushing and keyboard-TPU proof loads/durations with no slip, permanent set, brittle adhesive, or loss of removability
keyboard_rod_route.evidence: Approval ID, gauge ID, loads, durations, displacement, and before/after photos

keyboard_rod_route.method: Hand key-contact test before robot use
keyboard_rod_route.limit: Reliable key input through the TPU tip without hard-stop loading

phone_stylus_route.method: Qualified axial force-gauge pull and repeated removal check
phone_stylus_route.limit: Meets the engineering-approved stylus-collar proof load/duration with no slip, permanent set, or loss of serviceability
phone_stylus_route.evidence: Approval ID, gauge ID, load, duration, and before/after measurements

phone_stylus_route.method: Hand capacitive-contact test before robot use
phone_stylus_route.limit: Reliable touch response without hard-stop loading
phone_stylus_route.evidence: Manual tap count, successful taps, and video

steps.failure_recovery: Return to Step 00 for any failed printed body, cap, adapter, bushing, collar, TPU tip, hardware fit, spring/gripper measurement, or route-retention qualification. Keep reversible assembly, force/travel, functional-contact, or TCP calibration rework in Step 14. Reopen downstream signoffs after either correction.
steps.stop_gate: This is a contact tool, not a hard stop. Stop if travel binds, the spring coil-binds, the cap distorts, the adapter slips, or the selected contact route is not explicitly recorded.
handoff: Every selected route is labeled; unselected parts are segregated, not mistaken for accepted hardware.
Travel, force, return, retention, creep, function, and ten-cycle TCP results pass for every selected route.
Each selected route's installed-tool TCP and configuration record are saved.

steps.title: Final proof, calibration, and commissioning
steps.purpose: Prove the assembled cell mechanically, visually, and functionally before any automatic contact with the keyboard or phone.
steps.expected_result: Every acceptance gate has measured evidence, the cell passes empty motion and controlled first contact, and a responsible person signs the physical release decision.
required_inputs: Complete installed cell with devices initially removed
Signed evidence from Steps 00 through 14
Calibrated camera, board transform, accepted TCP cartridge, and compliant tool TCP
E-stop, calibrated force gauge or traceable weights, torque driver, measurement tools, and an observer

PASS engineering-release record `commissioning_motion_contact_limits_approved` for TCP speed (mm/s), TCP acceleration (mm/s^2), contact force (N), travel/clearance (mm), and 20 N/10 N proof durations (s); plus the fixed 50 N axial anchor proof for 60 seconds

Approved controller/firmware, E-stop and board anti-shift implementations, and existing project-relative homing/reference, empty-cell motion, and final-process files whose SHA-256 values match the approval record

hardware.condition: Test before robot enable

hardware.item: Force, torque, dimensional, and vision tools
hardware.condition: IDs and calibration status recorded

hardware.item: Accepted TCP cartridge and labeled spare
hardware.condition: Installed cartridge remains flush and repeatable

procedure: Before robot enable, verify the engineering-approved controller/firmware, E-stop implementation, board anti-shift implementation, homing/reference procedure, empty-cell program, final-process program, TCP speed (mm/s), TCP acceleration (mm/s^2), contact force (N), travel/clearance (mm), and 20 N/10 N proof-duration (s) record is PASS; verify every artifact SHA-256 and confirm the 50 N axial anchor proof duration is fixed at 60 seconds. If any approved field is blank, missing, stale, or changed by an operator, place commissioning on HOLD.
Reconcile every prior step folder: required evidence present, no unresolved HOLD, installed/spare counts correct, and no unapproved rework.
Torque-audit all nine board interfaces and inspect for bottoming, underside projection, veneer damage, base lift, and rail or slider mis-seating.
Remove and reinstall each station ten times; record X/Y, yaw, and Z repeatability and recheck the keyboard seam and TCP cartridge.
Run the board-tag detector and confirm all six tags meet detection and reprojection limits with the final camera settings.
Proof board anchors and station loads with the defined instruments and durations; record permanent shift.

Remove devices and removable tools, follow the approved homing/reference procedure, test the approved E-stop cutoff/reset and board anti-shift implementation, apply the recorded commissioning speed/force limits, and run only the SHA-256-bound empty-cell program.
Measure minimum clearance to the board, clamp proxy, camera support, cables, stations, and tag plane.
Load and verify one device at a time; perform first contact at controlled speed and force with an observer at the E-stop.
Run only the SHA-256-bound final-process program, then complete the physical release decision, responsible signature, date, revision, and evidence archive.

Update config/measurement_record.json through the controlled recording workflow and update sequential job lifecycle evidence in config/job_build_record.json. Regenerate BUILD_TRACKER.md/.json, JOB_KITS.csv-derived kit status, job cards, and this step package; verify the final records, then archive the immutable build-ID evidence.

acceptance.method: Ten remove/reinstall cycles per station
acceptance.limit: X/Y no more than 0.25 mm; yaw no more than 0.20 degrees; Z no more than 0.20 mm
acceptance.evidence: Cycle table and worst values

acceptance.method: Apply 20 N lateral and 10 N functional station proofs for the recorded durations, plus 50 N axial at every board anchor for 60 seconds
acceptance.limit: Every load/duration is achieved; permanent shift no more than 0.10 mm; no damage or rotation
acceptance.evidence: Force-tool ID, durations, before/after values, and photos

acceptance.method: Run the full path at the engineering-approved TCP speed/acceleration with devices removed
acceptance.limit: No collision and measured clearance never below the engineering-approved minimum
acceptance.evidence: Approval ID, actual mm/s and mm/s^2, motion log/video, cycle count, and clearance table

acceptance.criterion: Controlled first contact and final process
acceptance.method: One device at a time at the engineering-approved first-contact TCP speed/force/travel with an observer at the E-stop
acceptance.limit: All approved numeric limits respected; no device shift, hard stop, unintended input, or cable load
acceptance.evidence: Approval ID, actual mm/s, N and mm values, and signed commissioning record

steps.failure_recovery: Return to the earliest affected source step: board/anchors to Step 01, arm clamp/reinforcement to Step 02, keyboard to Steps 03-05, phone/TCP to Steps 06-10, tag placement to Steps 11-12, camera/vision to Step 13, or compliant tool/TCP to Step 14. Reopen and repeat every downstream acceptance affected by that change before commissioning resumes.
steps.stop_gate: Digital PASS is not physical release. Do not enable automatic device contact until every measured gate is in limit, evidence is archived, the E-stop works, and the physical release decision is signed.
handoff: All acceptance measurements and evidence are archived by revision.
The responsible release decision is signed and dated.
Installed parts, matched spares, tool route, camera settings, TCPs, and minimum clearance are recorded.
Any later part, device, camera, board, or tool change reopens the affected steps and commissioning gates.
